planner_json.title: Implement the claude-code adapter: pinned/newest install with DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1, marketplace add + plugin install, plugin-details list (no model), headless -p graded runs, system/init plugin gate, InstallationIdentity digest verification

requirements.title: Four grades per graded cell: command_list, status, verify, question_before_expensive_work — ask-nothing enforced, must-ask stops unanswered
requirements.description: GIVEN a claude-code cell installed at the resolved version with the plugin proven loaded on a real hosted runner WHEN the adapter runs the command list, the status check, the planted and clean verify invocations and the must-ask init probe THEN the cell carries four verdicts graded from files and event stream with zero question events in the ask-nothing streams and exactly one unanswered question in the must-ask probe
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: Fixture pair: claude-code pinned cell with four pass verdicts where list/status/verify streams contain zero question events and the init prefix stops at the first USER_CHOICE with no answer sent — module exits 0.
requirements.red_input: On base main the module cannot find any grade record (no test/harness exists) and exits 1 writing .red; locally, a fixture where the status check's stream contains a question flips verdict to fail.

scenario.topology_note: real claude-code CLI executes list/status/planted-verify/clean-verify/must-ask-init; keyless grader reads files plus CanonicalEvent streams; replay runs the same grader over archived real captures

would_fail_if: a question event appeared in any list/status/verify stream and the grader still passed that check (an empty question count must fail ask-nothing)
the must-ask probe graded pass with zero question events or with an answer delivered
a generic status reply passed the status check
verdicts were derived from exit codes instead of streams

forms: CanonicalEvent streams with original_event bytes and offsets
archived real captures with provenance hashes
examples: four check_ids with verdicts for claude-code/pinned
question event count 0 in ask-nothing streams
USER_CHOICE count 1, answers sent 0 in must-ask
evidence.required_capture: raw captured stdout per invocation with byte offsets, capture hashes, grader evidence citations

build_proof.range: anything that proves the four verdicts come from captured files and streams of real invocations
examples: per-check grade record citing a capture hash and stream offsets

steps: adapter runs the five real invocations via claude -p with stream-json
grader assigns four verdicts from files and streams

must_observe: status reply states platform "web-desktop", seeded phase, gate state, nonzero inventory counts matching StatusCase
must-ask capture contains exactly 1 valid USER_CHOICE and 0 answer deliveries
must_not_observe: any question event in list/status/verify streams
a scripted answer consumed by any first check
an empty checks array or null reason on a pass verdict

must_observe: grader returns "fail" citing the question event offset
must_not_observe: pass on a stream containing a question
synthetic event JSON with no capture provenance

requirements.title: Journey: planted-and-clean verify pair through a real dispatched run, from oracle precheck to summary links
requirements.description: GIVEN a dispatched harness-eval run on the hosted runner with the claude-code cells live WHEN the run completes and the maintainer downloads the verify-reports artifact THEN the planted report names atoms/Button/default with defect-detected and the clean twin reports clean_project_failed false, bound to distinct invocation ids of the same live run
requirements.verification_service: GitHub Actions harness-eval workflow + real harness CLIs + harness-smoke keys
requirements.positive_example: One real dispatched run whose artifact chain satisfies: oracle exited 1 on planted with drifted[].key atoms/Button/default and 0 on clean, planted report defect-detected at its declared path, clean report clean, both linked from the summary — module exits 0.
requirements.red_input: Base main: the journey cannot start (no workflow to dispatch, no oracle wrapper) — module exits 1 with .red.

scenario.topology_note: one live dispatch drives planted verify and clean twin through the real CLI on the runner; maintainer reads both reports; replay revalidates the downloaded pair

would_fail_if: the planted report went missing from an otherwise-evaluable run and the cell still passed — fail report-missing
the journey claimed execution from a cached replay instead of a live run — a static replay must grade not-executed, never pass

examples: planted: atoms/Button/default defect-detected; clean: clean_project_failed false
evidence.required_capture: live run_id/attempt binding, both invocation captures, maintainer's gate-step-13 reading

build_proof.range: anything that proves both reports came from one live run's distinct invocations
examples: two invocation ids in one run's verify-reports artifact

steps: read the defect name and twin result

must_observe: both bound to distinct `invocation_id`s of the same live run
must_not_observe: pass claimed from a replay with no live run
either report absent

steps: delete planted report from a copied artifact

must_observe: validator downgrades the check to fail "report-missing" (not could-not-run, not pass)
must_not_observe: the missing report excused as could-not-run report-unavailable
a silent pass
no report-missing downgrade recorded for the missing report

requirements.description: The claude-code pinned cell grades four separate check verdicts from files and event stream
The ask-nothing streams contain zero question events while the must-ask probe stops at exactly one unanswered question
The four-grades flow module requires each claude-code cell to record a dotted observed CLI version and a 64-hex plugin manifest digest
The four-grades flow module finds no harness API key on an install, marketplace, plugin-install or command-list step

seed/live-dispatch-run.entrypoint: gh workflow run harness-eval --repo hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect (real dispatch, checkout default)
seed/live-dispatch-run.description: RUN_ID + attempt-qualified artifacts via gh run download

seed/streams/question-in-ask-nothing.entrypoint: splice of real bytes only: USER_CHOICE from the must-ask capture inserted into the real verify stream, provenance hashes recorded

seed/streams/clean-verify-pass.entrypoint: real captured clean-verify invocation from the same qualification run

seed/case/verify-button-drift.entrypoint: test/harness/kit/project fresh copy + overlays/button-drift by the case loader
seed/case/verify-button-drift.description: planted invocation dir with declared report path

seed/case/verify-clean.entrypoint: same kit copy without overlay, separate fresh dir

planner_json.agent_rationale: Claude Code adapter code — CLI install, plugin manifest, headless invocation flags — is ai-tooling-implementer's stated surface per AGENTS.md.

specification.objective: Make claude-code a real, identity-bound, evidence-graded harness on a hosted runner — install, load proof, command list, and four graded invocations — for both tracks.
specification.success_state: A dispatched run yields two claude-code cells, each with `observed_cli_version` and `observed_plugin_manifest_sha256` present and matching the installed payload, the pinned cell's four checks graded `pass` from files and event stream, and the planted/clean verify pair landing at exactly their case-declared report paths.

design.pattern: none — headless product; the reader is the result artifact and the Actions summary (UC-GRD-01)

The ask-nothing streams contain zero question events while the must-ask probe stops at exactly one unanswered question
The four-grades flow module requires each claude-code cell to record a dotted observed CLI version and a 64-hex plugin manifest digest
The four-grades flow module finds no harness API key on an install, marketplace, plugin-install or command-list step

planner_json.why_required: serves FLOW-GRD-02-FOUR-GRADES and FLOW-JRN-PLANTED-AND-TWIN: the claude-code adapter is what produces the four graded invocations and the planted/clean verify pair those two flows read
